programme.desc: The Closet Case: Phil helps Haley convince Claire to allow Dylan to move in temporarily, but when he sees how intimate living together means, he has second thoughts.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: She Crazy: Phil is excited about project 'hatch the duck eggs', and even builds a whole habitat for them, but no one else seems as keen about the project.

programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
programme.desc: A short, cheeky clip featuring animals and food, from the always hilarious Tube that is Rude.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The Olde Stone Mill: Gordon Ramsay visits The Olde Stone Mill in Tuckahoe, New York. The restaurant has been restored, but owner Dean can't get customers through the door.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Lockdown: Peralta is left in charge of the precinct at Thanksgiving because Holt and Jeffords are away, but chaos ensues when a strange package is delivered.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: USPIS: While trying to catch a drug dealer, Peralta and Boyle join forces with Agent Jack Danger (Ed Helms), a pompous investigator at the US Postal Inspection Service.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Walking Big & Tall: Marge urges Homer to lose weight. Instead, he finds a support group that encourages him to embrace his size. Lisa writes an anthem for Springfield.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Princess Guide: Homer chaperones a Nigerian princess while her father negotiates a uranium deal with Mr Burns. He takes her to Moe's bar, where Moe begins to fall for her.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Carbon Dating and a Stuffed Raccoon: Sheldon gets into trouble with fellow child genius Paige at the Science Museum. Meemaw has a jumble sale in her garage.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: An 8-Bit Princess and a Flat Tire Genius: Meemaw gives Sheldon his first video game. George Sr gets jealous when Georgie bonds with Herschel from the garage.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Wild: Mitch, Cam and Phil crash Jay's annual hiking trip to find an elusive bald eagle. And Gloria, Alex, Claire and Haley get together to plan a baby shower.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Stand by Your Man: Dylan and Luke are impressed by Bill's tales of heroism as a firefighter, which makes Phil feel emasculated. So he invites the guys over for male bonding.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Cornhusker Vortex: Sheldon teaches Leonard about American football so that he can try to fit in with Penny's friends. And Raj and Sheldon have a kite-fighting contest.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Guitarist Amplification: Sheldon is annoyed when Leonard and Penny argue about Penny's male friend staying over and he has to act as peacemaker.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Adhesive Duck Deficiency: Leonard, Raj and Howard go on a camping trip that alters their minds. Penny dislocates her shoulder when she slips in the shower.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Vengeance Formulation: Howard massively overcompensates for avoiding Bernadette.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Boyle-Linetti Wedding: The squad are all given tasks to complete for Gina's mum's wedding to Boyle's dad.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Captain Peralta: Peralta's father, an airline pilot who hasn't played a big part in his life, comes to town. Holt sets the squad an impossible brain teaser.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Grampy Can Ya Hear Me: Grampa's new hearing aid tells him more about the world than he wants to know. Skinner learns that his mother shattered his boyhood dream.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Mr. Lisa's Opus: In her Harvard application, 18-year-old Lisa recounts the story of her childhood - including the time when Marge planned to leave Homer...

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Zazzy Substitution: The guys are concerned when a heartbroken Sheldon starts bulk buying cats after he breaks up with Amy, so Leonard tries to get Sheldon's mother to visit.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Hot Troll Deviation: An embarrassing secret of Howard's comes to light as he tries to win back Bernadette. Sheldon and Raj have trouble working together.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Desperation Emanation: Leonard realises he's the only one of the gang with no girlfriend. Sheldon wants to get rid of his when she hatches a plan for him to meet her mother.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Irish Pub Formulation: A visit from Raj's sister Priya creates tension among the guys, especially when Leonard asks Sheldon to conceal his romantic past with her.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Last Barfighter: A secret society of bartenders seek vengeance on Homer and his friends after Moe breaks their most sacred rule.

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Sex, Pies and Idiot Scrapes: Homer and Flanders become bounty hunters. Marge gets a job at an erotic bakery.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Frink Gets Testy: When Mr Burns panics about the apocalypse and builds a cosmic ark, Professor Frink develops a test to work out who deserves a place on it.

programme.title: New: Below Deck Sailing Yacht
